title: The Effect of Leucine on Body Composition and Muscle Characteristics in Elderly, Type 2 Diabetes Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether long term leucine supplementation has a positive effect on body composition and muscle characteristics in elderly, type 2 diabetes patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of type 2 diabetes

Exclusion Criteria:

* Impaired renal or liver function
* Cardiac disease
* Subjects with metal implants
* Hypertension
* Diabetes complications
* Exogenous insulin therapy
